header.name: Genetics and Molecular Biology
header.description: The aim of this basic core course is to provide students a good background in genetics, molecular biology.  The major focus is to acquaint students with quantitative aspect of different kind of genetic inheritance and horizontal transfers. The course is also to provide introduction about different aspect of molecular aspect of gene regulation.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Students can solve statistical problem of mendelian inheritance

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Students can summarise non-mendelian inheritance and horizontal gene transfer

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: student can summarise different aspects of regulation through epigenome and proteome

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: student can solve quantitative problem of population genetics

lecture_topics: An Introduction to DNA structure and variations
statistical aspect of mendelian inheritance and non-mendelian genetics
Bacterial and Viral gene transfers evolution
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Lab (tentative) :  DNA extraction, purification, amplication  Assignment -1: statistical problem related to mendelian and non-mendelian inheritance

lecture_topics: Detail of Gene regulation /contol of gene expression in prokaryotes and eukaryotes
Detail of Molecular biology aspect of epigenome and proteome invloved in regulation
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Lab  (tentative) :  RNA extraction, reverse transcription Assignment-2: Reading of publications related to regulation and summarising in own words

lecture_topics: Introduction to sources of data in genomics, proteomics and population genetics for quantitaive analysis
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Assignment-3: solving numerical problem related to population genetics
